comments: The tool evaluates subtitle/caption files rather than a full webpage. It is useful for checking WCAG-related caption readability issues such as reading speed, duration and overlaps. It runs in the browser without signup and is free during open beta.
features: Checks subtitle files for timing, overlap, duration, reading-speed, line-length and consistency issues. Supports SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, LRC and related formats. The browser tool generates a QA report to help creators and translators prepare readable captions before publishing or localization.
title: AllSubConverter Subtitle Checker
